date_note: Date is the article's publication day; the article is a breaking-news item on the same day.
title: Korean subcommittee does not conclude on revenue-based fine for hacked financial firms; to be discussed again next month, Newspim reports
summary: Newspim reports the Political Affairs Committee's first bill review subcommittee did not reach agreement on an amendment to the electronic financial transactions law that would fine hacked financial firms by a share of revenue. Disputes were over the fine basis and exemptions; it is to be discussed again next month. Money Today's earlier headline had said the bill passed.
plain: Newspim reports a Korean parliamentary subcommittee did not settle a bill to fine hacked financial firms by a share of revenue and will take it up again next month.
exec: Newspim reports a bill to fine hacked financial firms by a share of revenue was not settled and will return to the subcommittee next month.

validation.note: Newspim says no conclusion; Money Today's headline said the bill passed (its body was unreadable). The sources conflict, so the record follows Newspim's article text.
